🧩 Components

🔘Button

Triggers an action or event — the primary way users move through the product.

Save 80% with the Iron Suite

Read the engine comparison

🔗Text Link

Two variants for two contexts: Plain for general/marketing pages — coloured text, no underline.

☑️Checkbox

A control that lets the user toggle between checked and not checked — for accepting terms, multi-select lists and selectable cards.

⌨️Input

A single-line text field for collecting short user input — email, name, search.

📝Textarea

A multi-line text field for longer input — messages, descriptions, feedback.

📎File Upload

A dashed dropzone for attaching a file — drag-and-drop or click to browse.

Panel content lives in the slot.
🪟Flyout Menu

A trigger that reveals a floating panel of navigation links — the mega-menu pattern behind PRODUCTS on ironsoftware.com.

⦿Radio

Lets the user pick exactly one option from a set.

🔽Select

A trigger that opens a menu to pick one value from a longer list — countries, plans, statuses.

🏷️Badge

A small, non-interactive label that conveys status, category or count.

Please note: Trial keys are issued once per email address and last thirty days.

💡Notice

A non-interactive informational block — disclaimers, notes, tips, callouts.

One component over the three logo families: 24 square product marks (colour + mono), 5 wordmark lockups, and 13 illustrative product elements.
